correctness.rationale: The finite-level state congruences D_3 and D_5 were directly recomputed. A uniform binomial matrix interpolation proves two isometric dyadic balls, a third complete dyadic ball, and one Morse-type square branch with unique 2-adic critical point. Disjointness and square-residue counting give R(k) for all k and Haar measure 7/12; verifier exhaustively checks k=1..14 and the critical residue projection. Boundaries, exact period and convergence are proved.

value.rationale: Classifies a natural infinite tower of target residue sets for the well-known Tribonacci recurrence, not merely divisibility of individual terms. The precise 7/12 Haar measure and a square-critical component reveal structure that valuation-only theorems do not specify; all finite-level cardinalities are an exact new natural invariant. Limited priority uncertainty is disclosed.
